meta.title: Check a certificate · Chiibitsu Labs
meta.description: Check a Chiibitsu Labs course certificate by its number. Shows whether it is valid, revoked or not found.

placeholder: Placeholder. This is sample data while the certificate record is being agreed. It is not a real certificate.

valid.body: Chiibitsu Labs issued this certificate, and has not revoked it. Its record is sealed on the Aikiri Network, so the date it was sealed cannot be changed after the fact.

revoked.body: Chiibitsu Labs issued this certificate and later revoked it. It no longer counts as proof that the course was completed.

notFound.body: Chiibitsu Labs has no certificate with this number. Check it against the certificate, character by character. If it still is not found, this page cannot vouch for it.

honest.heading: What this page shows
items: Only what Chiibitsu Labs issued. A Chiibitsu Labs certificate says a person finished a Chiibitsu Labs course.
It is not a government certification, licence or accredited qualification.
Valid means the record exists, is not revoked, and is sealed on the public Aikiri ledger. It does not say what the person can do today.
One certificate at a time: the one whose number you have. There is no list or search of certificates.
